mostWorthwhile.text: The practice fault and second handoff were most worthwhile: distinguishing a missing signal from lost power, then having another operator repeat the checks, made the training feel concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to combine the completed practice panel with the cupboard was frustrating; it left the route to the handoff unclear until I inspected the cupboard.

surprise.text: The alarm could not be connected directly to the tested link; installing the spare repeater first also revealed a useful bypass for maintenance.

arbitrary.text: Using the residents' fobs on the cupboard made sense once shown, but the completed practice panel could not combine with it despite the shared handoff goal.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical fault diagnosis and the emphasis on other people being able to maintain the infrastructure made me curious about what the neighborhood does next, although the blocked combinations were occasionally unclear.
